title: al-Khaṣāʾiṣ (projected work on logic)

date.basis: no date given; referred to in the K. al-Manāhij (completed 833/1430 per the timeline); MK: it does not seem ever to have been finished; the R. Ḥurūf's Khaṣāyiṣ-i Kamālī is presumably a different work.

occasion: Referred to in the K. al-Manāhij as a more comprehensive work on logic than that primer.
manuscript: No MS copies are known to survive.
summary: A more comprehensive work on logic, with a wider frame of reference than the peripatetics, that the author refers to in the K. al-Manāhij; apparently never finished.
